description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'Minify_Controller_Base' which serves as a base class for minification controllers in the Minify package. It includes methods for setting up sources, retrieving default options, loading minifiers, and analyzing sources, along with class properties and documentation.

classes.name: Minify_Controller_Base
classes.description: An abstract base class for Minify controllers that handles request validation, source creation, option management, and minifier loading.

methods.name: getDefaultMinifyOptions
methods.description: Returns default options for Minify, including content type, encoding, cache settings, and headers.

methods.name: getDefaultMinifers
methods.description: Provides default minifier callbacks for JavaScript, CSS, and HTML.

methods.name: loadMinifier
methods.description: Loads minification code on demand based on the callback, following PEAR conventions.

methods.name: mixInDefaultOptions
methods.description: Merges default options with user-provided options, including minifiers.

methods.name: analyzeSources
methods.description: Analyzes sources to set content type and last modified time for caching.
